patch_description: Crossover of the two programs (which differ only in `balanced_packing`): keep the vectorized layer-parallel `balanced_packing` from the current program (fastest algorithm time), and replace the sequential `replicate_experts` loop with a vectorized water-filling approach. The replica counts are computed with a binary search on the load threshold T: each expert gets c_i = max(1, ceil(w_i/T)), and we find the minimal T such that sum(c_i) <= num_phy. Remaining slots are then handed out greedily (few iterations, fully vectorized per step). Finally, `phy2log`/`rank` are constructed directly from the counts via `repeat_interleave` instead of a Python loop over every redundant expert. This reduces the algorithm runtime (O(log) binary-search steps + few extras instead of O(num_redundant) tensor ops per step) while giving at least as good load balance (water-filling is the optimal greedy for minimizing max w_i/c_i), improving both the speed and expert-level balancedness. Inputs/outputs unchanged.
